text.en:
After Shooting an Ammo Pickup:
Picks up Ammo and <title refills [G_refill] /> all Weapons from reserves.

Triggers Ammo Pickup effects. Only activates if picking up ammo is possible.

enhanced (
#e Passively grants +5 Range.
)
text.zh-chs:
命中弹药盒时：
拾取弹药盒并从备弹中 <title 重新装填 [G_refill] /> 所有武器。

可触发弹药拾取相关特性。仅在可以拾取弹药时触发。

enhanced (
#e 被动提升 +5 射程。
)

After dealing Weapon Damage to an Ammo Brick:
Picks up Ammo and <title refills [G_refill] /> all Weapons from reserves.
Triggers Ammo Pickup Effects if pickup is possible.

Direct Weapon Hits collect Orbs of Power.

)

text.en:
On Weapon Hits against an Ammo Brick:
Picks up Ammo, <title Refills [G_refill] /> all Weapons from reserves, and triggers Ammo Pickup Effects.

Only activates if picking up ammo is possible (i.e. reserves are not full).

Direct Weapon Hits collect Orbs of Power.

)

text.en:
On Weapon Hits against an Ammo Brick:
Picks up Ammo, <title Refills [G_refill] /> all Weapons from reserves, and triggers Ammo Pickup Effects.

Only activates if picking up ammo is possible. However, shooting a <special/>Special Ammo Brick (with at least one <special/>Special Weapon equipped) will bypass this restriction.

Weapon Hits against Orbs of Power collect them. 

enhanced (
#e Passively grants 5 Range.
)
